_purpose: Single source of truth for the V2 location space. schema_v2.json is GENERATED from this file by gen_schema_v2.py. Never hand-edit schema_v2.json.

carried_from_v1._note: UNCHANGED from schema.json v1. Container semantics ('put it IN box 1') do not survive translation to a flat surface cell, so boxes stay boxes. This also leaves 36 seen rows and 18 held-out rows untouched by the V2 rewrite.

retired_v1_locations._note: Replaced by grid cells in V2. Retained only so the V1->V2 worksheet can map them and the demo can alias them. NEVER emitted into the v2 enum.

grid._status: LOCKED at 3x3. Rationale: English has clean names for far/mid/near x left/mid/right and nothing reliable for a 5-wide ring. Naming ambiguity, not reachability, is the binding constraint.
grid._row_order: A = furthest from robot base (largest x), E = nearest (smallest x).
grid._why_odd: Odd x odd so the geometric centre is a real cell (C3). A 4x4 grid has no centre cell, forcing a separate 'table_center' symbol and reintroducing two-correct-answers ambiguity.

runtime_symbols._note: Furthest legal cell on the commanded bearing. The LLM cannot know the sweep result, so the GOLD LABEL is the symbol itself, never the resolved cell.
Resolved against current object occupancy. Gold label is the symbol.

geometry._status: MEASURED — sim/reachability.py, 9x9 sweep, 3 trials/candidate, margin 0.03 m. Reproduced identically on Windows (thesis env) and Linux container.

backend_frames.mujoco_fetch: world frame, FetchPickAndPlace-v4, table0 top z=0.400

geometry._min_pitch_rationale: full_grasp_backend.pick_place scores ok when gap < 0.06 m. If cell pitch <= 0.06 m, a place at the WRONG adjacent cell still scores ok and per-cell execution success is meaningless. Measured V1 footprint is 0.240 m x 0.240 m; 5x5 over that gives pitch exactly 0.060 m, which FAILS. A 5x5 grid therefore requires the sweep to find a usable span of at least 0.30 m per axis. Fallback ladder: 5x5 (needs >=0.30 m), 4x4 (needs >=0.24 m, no centre cell), 3x3 (needs >=0.18 m, only 9 cells = no growth over V1).

reachability._status: MEASURED — every on-table candidate legal. No donut: the Fetch end-effector is mocap-welded, so there is no IK failure mode inside the table.
reachability._expected_shape: SUPERSEDED. Donut prediction was a real-arm expectation; MuJoCo Fetch does not reproduce it. Off-table targets are the only failure mode.
